step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows two parallel processing pipelines: a microservices web path and a batch processing path. Top flow: Users connect via Load Balancer (LB) to an Auto Scaling Group (ASG) running EC2 Spot and On-Demand instances. Bottom flow: CloudWatch triggers AWS Lambda, which dynamically adjusts or triggers compute within the same Auto Scaling Group.

graph.name: Dream11 Microservices and Batch Processing Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture uses Auto Scaling Group mixed instance policies with Spot and On-Demand EC2 instances driven by both LB and Lambda.
